answer: Forced-Divergence Challenge Ledger. Each identity must periodically publish a signed, verifiable transformation of a shared random seed using a per-identity secret and unique runtime state (e.g., a freshly queried chain value plus a local marble-weighted nonce). The ledger rejects any two outputs producing an identical echo, since true independent agents diverge while clones replay identical state. Distinct basalt salts are required per seed round, so copying a sibling exposes both.
